# FAIR-bioHeaders vocabulary

<!-- Generated by scripts/make_jsonld.py from the LinkML model (schemas/core.yaml and
fhr_linkml.yml); do not edit. -->

This page defines the FAIR-bioHeaders terms that the [JSON-LD context](../jsonld/fhr.context.jsonld)
uses where schema.org has no suitable term. The namespace is `https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#`. It is unversioned: a term
IRI never changes and is never reused with another meaning. A deprecated term is kept and marked
deprecated.

- Machine-readable forms: [jsonld/terms.ttl](../jsonld/terms.ttl) (Turtle) and
  [jsonld/terms.jsonld](../jsonld/terms.jsonld) (JSON-LD).
- How records use the terms: [JSONLD.md](JSONLD.md) and the
  [mapping table](../mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml).
- Licence: MPL-2.0. To cite a term, give its IRI and the FHR-Specification release.

Each heading is the term's local name, so `https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#checksum` is the section `#checksum` below.

## Classes

### Agent

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#Agent`. Class.

A person or organization that the FHR record does not classify; FHR records the kind of agent through nameType or an ORCID or ROR identifier.

- Subclass of: `sdo:Thing`
- Close match: `dcterms:Agent`

### VitalStats

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#VitalStats`. Class.

General statistics about the genome assembly. N50, N90, L50 and L90 are contig statistics; the scaffold* variants are the scaffold statistics.

- Subclass of: `sdo:StructuredValue`

## Properties

### accessionID

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#accessionID`. Property.

Genome assembly accession

- Used on: Dataset (the FHR record)
- Value: PropertyValue
- Subproperty of: `sdo:identifier`
- DCMI: `dcterms:identifier` (conditional) (see the [mapping table](../mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml))

### assemblyProtocol

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#assemblyProtocol`. Property.

Assembly protocol or workflow reference URI.

- Used on: Dataset (the FHR record)
- Value: URL
- DCMI: `dcterms:relation` (broader) (see the [mapping table](../mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml))

### assemblySoftware

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#assemblySoftware`. Property.

Assembly software provenance or a legacy name.

- Used on: Dataset (the FHR record)
- Value: Text, SoftwareApplication
- DCMI: none (see the [mapping table](../mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml))

### checksum

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#checksum`. Property.

sha2-512/256 checksum value for hashing

- Used on: Dataset (the FHR record)
- Value: Text
- DCMI: none (see the [mapping table](../mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml))

### commandLineOption

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#commandLineOption`. Property.

Command-line options given to the assembly software, in order

- Used on: SoftwareApplication (an `assemblySoftware` item)
- Value: Text
- DCMI: none (see the [mapping table](../mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml))

### gcContent

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#gcContent`. Property.

GC content as a percentage from 0 to 100, not a fraction (write 42.0 for 42 percent; 0.42 means 0.42 percent)

- Used on: VitalStats (the `vitalStats` object)
- Value: Number
- DCMI: none (see the [mapping table](../mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml))

### instrument

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#instrument`. Property.

Physical tools and instruments used in the creation of the genome assembly

- Used on: Dataset (the FHR record)
- Value: Text
- DCMI: none (see the [mapping table](../mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml))

### L50

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#L50`. Property.

`https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/terms#L90`. Property.
